title: each item must have an id and at least one content field

spec.name: JSON Feed
spec.normative_quote: id (required, string) is unique for that item for that feed over time... content_html and content_text are each optional, but at least one is required.
spec.note: Recalled from training-data familiarity with the published JSON Feed 1.1 spec, not re-verified against a live fetch this session (this agent has no WebFetch access). The deferred drift probe (ADR 0011 follow-up (h)) must reconcile this quote against a live re-fetch of spec.url before it is treated as verified.

applicability: An entry in a parsed feed.json document's "items" array.
expectation: The item has an "id", and at least one of "content_html" / "content_text".

cases.name: an item with neither content_html nor content_text
